title: Untitled Goose Game
notes: Official Windows Steam build 6172342 under Proton Experimental. The world advances during inference, so the game is real-time and frozen Trials use verified process suspension. Each episode starts at the title screen with no slot saves. Progress is scored only from game-written BinaryFormatter slot saves.
introduction: Untitled Goose Game is a real-time puzzle game in a fixed village. You control a goose through the garden, high street, back gardens and pub, then reach the model village, take its bell and return the bell to the starting area to finish the game. The run starts from a new game at the title screen with no completed tasks.
controls: Left-click a visible destination to walk there; clicking farther away keeps the goose moving toward that point. Move the mouse to aim the head. The right mouse button uses the beak. Hold Control to bend the neck. Space honks, X flaps the wings and Tab shows the task list.
